jobs.title: Affiliate Athletic Trainer
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox Medical team is dedicated to providing our players with the highest level of sports medicine care in professional baseball, maximizing short- and long-term health and performance within the organization’s philosophies and processes. We integrate every area of the medical team with adjacent performance departments to reduce injury and illness rates, deliver precise and timely evaluation and treatment, and build long-term strategies that educate players and staff on health and performance best practices. Selected candidates will have access to the Boston Red Sox’s internal orthopedic and manual therapy education platform. They will also gain hands-on experience as part of a professional sports medicine team, with opportunities to work alongside the Major League staff during Spring Training.

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

jobs.description_text: The Role As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round. Key Responsibilities Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned. Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards. Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions. Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized.
